articles.title: China-Nepal floods: 261 foreigners missing in Tibet, online rumours targeted - South China Morning Post
articles.description: Nepalese and Indians account for more than half of nationals from 23 countries missing after devastating glacier collapse four days ago.
articles.content:
The missing foreigners were from 23 different countries and included 104 Nepalese citizens, authorities in Tibets Gyirong county told reporters.
